- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1917-1920 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_own_pr_guard_enabled` uses `tr -d '[:space:]'`, which deletes all whitespace, so a malformed value such as `n o` or `f alse` becomes `no` or `false` and turns the own-PR re-issue guard off; the Python `_own_pr_guard_enabled` (`.strip().lower()`, scripts/unblock_actions.py:401-405) keeps the guard on for the same value.
  WHY: When the guard is off, `unblock_resolve_own_prs` returns early without the own-PR read and the G2 refusal check is skipped, so a `reissue` creates the replacement while the original `ai/issue-<n>` PR stays open; this breaks the documented "any other value keeps this safety guard on" contract. Severity: MAJOR from minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, mapped here to high; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1937-1964 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `unblock_resolve_own_prs`, the overflow check `totalCount > (nodes | length)` (line 1952) runs before the jq `select` that drops cross-repository, foreign-repository and foreign-author PRs, and the GraphQL `headRefName` filter also matches fork PRs.
  WHY: 11 or more open fork or foreign-author PRs named `ai/issue-<n>` make every own-PR read for that issue `unknown`, so every `reissue` is refused with `own_pr_unknown` while those PRs stay open. Outsiders control this, and it contradicts "A pull request from a fork, or by another author, is ignored by G1 to G3", although it fails safe. Severity: NIT from all reviewers that stated one, mapped here to low; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1917-1918 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shell `unblock_own_pr_guard_enabled` uses `tr -d '[:space:]'` to strip all whitespace, while the Python implementation in `scripts/unblock_actions.py` uses `strip()`, which removes only leading/trailing whitespace.
  WHY: A malformed value with internal spaces (e.g. `n o`) is read as `no` by the shell, which turns the guard OFF, while Python treats it as invalid and keeps the guard ON. This can bypass the safety guard in the shell path.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1937-1952 (inside `unblock_resolve_own_prs`) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The overflow check `(.data.repository.pullRequests.totalCount ...) > (.data.repository.pullRequests.nodes | length)` runs before the jq `select` that filters PRs by cross-repository status, author, and head repository.
  WHY: Many open fork PRs named `ai/issue-<n>` count toward `totalCount` but are filtered out later, so the read is falsely reported as `unknown` and the judge refuses re-issues.
